sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 234789 (21 sites)

values.note: $22/night on recreation.gov's 2026 rate table (the FS page, last updated April 2025, still says $18). First vehicle included; a second vehicle is $5/night, collected at the campground (2 passenger vehicles per site at most).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234789/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-21 to 2026-09-19, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $22) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234789 (notice 'You are allowed 2 passenger vehicles per site, the first vehicle is included in the site fee and an extra vehicle charge of $5.00/vehicle per night will be collected at the campground'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lost-johnny-point-campground ('A 50% discount on all standard site fees and day use fees will be offered to holders of the Golden Age and Golden Access Passports, as well as holders of the Interagency Senior and Access Passes.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. 12 of the 21 sites book on recreation.gov; 9 are first-come walk-up sites marked W, and reservation holders may not move to one on arrival. recreation.gov also caps a camper at 32 nights a year.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234789 (Overview '21 camp sites, 12 which are reservable and 9 for our walk-up visitors. The stay limit is 16 consecutive days.'; rules maxStay 32 nights Each Year) + recreation.gov site search for facility 234789 (12 reservable, 9 not) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lost-johnny-point-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Mid to Late May - End of September'.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lost-johnny-point-campground (Seasons of Use 'Mid to Late May - End of September'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service says 'Max trailer length is 22 feet.' The recreation.gov catalog lists longer per-site vehicle lengths (24-49 ft); the agency's own limit is kept.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lost-johnny-point-campground (Restrictions 'Max trailer length is 22 feet.'; '21 overnight sites for tent and RV camping') + recreation.gov site search for facility 234789 (max vehicle lengths 24-49), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water is for jugs only, not an RV fill station: arrive with the tank full. Paved roads and parking spurs, concrete boat ramp in the campground, on-site host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234789 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. The water is not a fill station but only for your water jugs so bring your RV water full. Campground roads and parking spurs are paved.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/lost-johnny-point-campground ('a concrete boat ramp is accessible from within the campground'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF campground on a point of the west shore of Hungry Horse Reservoir, ~3,600 ft: from US 2 at milepost 144 cross Hungry Horse Dam on West Side Rd (FR 895), paved to the campground 6 mi south of the dam (~10 mi from Hungry Horse). Distinct from the smaller Lost Johnny CG. ~18 mi SW of Glacier NP's West Glacier entrance. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page: confirmed $22 (2026 rec.gov rate; FS page still says $18), 21 sites (12 reservable / 9 walk-up), 22-ft max trailer, vault toilets, jug-fill drinking water, 16-day limit. Added recreation.gov platform, $5 extra vehicle, Senior/Access 50%, season mid/late May - end of September, concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds. Note corrected (it said ~35 mi SE of Hungry Horse; the FS says 10 mi, rec.gov 6 mi south of the dam) and trimmed of restated sites, hookups, facilities, length and stay limit. No Flathead NF alert for the campground or FR 895.
